mapper.insert: INSERT INTO skill_manage (name, description, content, category, tags, owner_user_id, status, like_count, retrieval_name) VALUES (#{name}, #{description}, #{content}, #{category}, #{tags}, #{ownerUserId}, #{status}, 0, #{retrievalName})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM skill_manage WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE skill_manage SET status='DELETED', deleted_at=NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) > 0 FROM skill_manage WHERE name = #{name} AND status <> 'DELETED'
SELECT like_count FROM skill_manage WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE skill_manage SET like_count = like_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE skill_manage SET like_count = GREATEST(like_count - 1, 0) WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT content FROM skill_manage WHERE retrieval_name = #{retrievalName} AND status <> 'DELETED' LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM skill_manage WHERE (owner_user_id = #{userId} OR id IN (SELECT target_skill_id FROM skill_reference WHERE creator = #{userId})) AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted_at IS NULL

mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT tags FROM skill_manage WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND tags IS NOT NULL AND tags != '' AND id IN (SELECT skill_id FROM skill_publish WHERE status = 'APPROVED')

SELECT p.id, p.skill_id, p.target_type, p.target_id, p.target_name, p.status, p.submitter, p.approver, p.approve_time, p.current_approver_user_id, p.last_approval_comment, p.last_approval_at, p.created_at, s.name AS skill_name, s.description AS skill_description, s.category AS skill_category FROM skill_publish p LEFT JOIN skill_manage s ON s.id = p.skill_id WHERE p.current_approver_user_id = #{approverUserId} AND p.status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY p.created_at DESC

SELECT p.id, p.skill_id, p.target_type, p.target_id, p.target_name, p.status, p.submitter, p.approver, p.approve_time, p.current_approver_user_id, p.last_approval_comment, p.last_approval_at, p.created_at, s.name AS skill_name, s.description AS skill_description, s.category AS skill_category FROM skill_publish p LEFT JOIN skill_manage s ON s.id = p.skill_id WHERE p.approver = #{approverUserId} AND p.status IN ('APPROVED', 'REJECTED') ORDER BY p.approve_time DESC
